text: In the AISafetyAtlas.Knowledge Lean module, the theorem knowable_iff_no_collision makes the obstruction to knowability exactly a colliding pair, and the module also records the theorem knowable_iff_factorsThrough. Knowability transfers to any more informative observation: if finer Determines coarser and the property is knowable from coarser, it is knowable from finer (Knowable.mono).
